entwurf.thema: Claude Code token overhead before building a game

teile.name: Hook
teile.text: Planning a game with Claude Code? Check this first. Systima measured roughly 33,000 tokens sent before a one-line prompt arrives.
teile.szene: Original painted open-world-game poster style: a black-haired man in a black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses sits at a dim desk, frowning at a laptop's glow, medium shot, neon city night behind him.

teile.name: Comparison
teile.text: That's system prompt, tool schemas and scaffolding. OpenCode used about 7,000 in the same test, on the same model and machine.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter in a leather jacket weighs a tall stack of glowing blocks against a small stack on a workshop bench, side-lit, medium shot, urban loft setting.

teile.name: Instruction file
teile.text: Add a project instruction file and it grows. Systima says a 72KB file adds roughly 20,000 tokens to every request.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and cyan glasses stacks heavy glowing crates onto a growing pile beside a rooftop terminal, close-medium shot, dusk orange light.

teile.name: Twist
teile.text: Is it just wasteful? Not always. One multi-step task totaled less, because Claude Code batches tool calls into fewer requests.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter raises an eyebrow, then smiles, as many small parcels slide into a few large boxes on a conveyor, medium shot, warm street light.

teile.name: Reversal
teile.text: But re-run on a newer model, it reversed: roughly 298,000 tokens against OpenCode's 133,000. The meter starts higher; the session decides who spends more.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the presenter in leather jacket and cyan glasses watches two runners at a city track, one starting with a heavy backpack, wide shot, cool blue twilight.

teile.name: Limit
teile.text: Planning a game with Claude Code now includes budgeting that baseline. Sources don't cover Steam publishing; check Steam's official guides.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the cyan-glasses presenter stands at a city rooftop edge studying a distant glowing skyline, thoughtful expression, wide shot, deep blue dusk, calm empty sky above.

teile.name: Ending
teile.text: Like, share and save this video before you plan.
teile.szene: Original painted game-poster style: the presenter in black leather jacket and glowing cyan glasses grins and sketches a game idea on a whiteboard in a bright studio, medium shot, warm light.

entwurf.beschreibung: Systima's test measured how many tokens Claude Code and OpenCode send before reading a prompt. Results came from one setup and varied by task and model; our sources don't cover Steam publishing.
